notes: Read all 377 numbered source lines before editing. This is pure, non-visual date/time formatting logic — no JSX, no DOM, no React, no API path, no unit-suffixed field, no i18n strings. It relies only on `Date` and the ECMAScript `Intl.DateTimeFormat` API, both standard runtime features available identically under Hermes (React Native) and Node (Jest), so no DOM shim or 'unavailable' fallback state is needed. The TS lib resolves the Intl types used (`Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions`, `formatToParts` via es2017.intl pulled by es2019; `Date.toLocale*(locales, options)` via es2020.date which references es2020.intl for `LocalesArgument`).

L1-22 file-level JSDoc (UTC source-of-truth, optional FormatOptions tz/locale override, the universal '—' garbage-in placeholder contract) preserved verbatim, followed by a native-port header documenting why the module ports unchanged and the single isFiniteNumber adaptation.

L24 `import { isFiniteNumber } from './numberFormat'` is the ONLY structural change: the native web-parity tree does not yet contain a ported numberFormat.ts, so importing it would dangle and fail tsc. The web `isFiniteNumber` is a one-line, side-effect-free predicate (`typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v)`); it is inlined verbatim as a private (non-exported) local function so dateFormat's public API surface and runtime behavior stay byte-for-byte identical. Documented in the file header + sidecar.

L37-42 intlOpts (spreads timeZone only when opts.tz set) and L44-51 intlLocale (whitespace/empty locale -> undefined to avoid Intl RangeError) ported with comments intact.

L53-91 the four absolute formatters formatDateTime / formatDate / formatDateShort / formatTime ported with identical Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions field sets (year/month/day/hour/minute combinations) and the nullish + isNaN(getTime()) '—' guards; formatTime keeps the `localeArg ? localeArg : []` empty-array locales argument exactly.

L93-109 formatRelative ported with identical thresholds (just now <60s, Nm ago <60m, Nh ago <24h, Nd ago <7d, else formatDate fallback).
